Personality: Wendel is generous and hospitable, similar in stature to his father, and willing to maintain family dignity at banquets and on the battlefield. He is not good at intrigues and believes more in public commitments.
Background: Wendel is the son of Wyman Manderly and a knight of the Manderly family of White Harbor. He was drafted into military service in the North, and his personal actions were always connected to his family, the port, and his old Stark friendship.
